title: Fix two simple bugs in a Rust string-utils library: off-by-one and panic on empty
description: A Rust string-utils library has two injected bugs: an off-by-one in word_count and a panic on empty string in capitalize_words. Both bugs have failing tests.

task_spec.prompt:
The Rust library in src/lib.rs has two bugs introduced by a bad commit:

Bug 1 — word_count off-by-one: The function returns 1 for empty strings instead of 0. Fix the early-return for empty strings to return 0.

Bug 2 — capitalize_words panics on empty: The map closure uses &w[0..1] which panics if the word is empty string (and on empty input there are no words — but the split_whitespace guarantees non-empty words, so the real fix is handling the case where s is empty). Fix the function to return an empty String when the input is empty or all whitespace, without panicking.

After fixing both bugs, cargo test must show 5/5 passing with no failures.
required_artifacts: capitalize_words returns empty string for empty input without panicking
success_criteria: Both fixes are minimal — change only what is broken
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
